description: Branch R-FMT-2 Scalar boundaries: Money ties and overflow, on an ACCDB. MT(ID Long, Fc Currency). The same 13 amounts (ties at the fifth decimal in both signs, values just either side of a tie, and the half-unit beyond both Currency limits) are written by three routes, each ID range separate: SQL numeric literals (IDs 1..), a table-recordset Field.Value put of VT_R8 (IDs 101..), and the SQL conversion CCur(literal) (IDs 201..). Each write has dbFailOnError or a marked Errors read. Asks whether the fifth decimal rounds half to even or half away, whether the route matters, and what overflows.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
